sections.label: Rain on the Glass (Intro)
sections.instruction: Establish quiet atmosphere with gentle tape hiss, soft ocean rain, and an intimate solo felt piano phrase.

sections.label: Warm Lamp & Ledger (Theme A)
sections.instruction: Introduce subtle dusty kick-snare brush groove, round warm sub-bass, and Rhodes harmonic counterpoint.

sections.label: Turning Light (Theme B)
sections.instruction: Rich Ghibli-esque harmonic progression with delicate melodic phrasing on upper piano register.

sections.label: Midnight Solitude (Outro)
sections.instruction: Rhythm drops out gently, letting a warm resolving major 7th chord ring out beneath gentle rain.
